endpoints.title: Elasticsearch endpoints
endpoints.description: List of Elasticsearch/OpenSearch node URLs (e.g. http://localhost:9200).

index.title: Index name
index.description: Name of the index (or data stream) audit documents are written to and searched from.

username.title: Authentication user
username.description: User used to authenticate against Elasticsearch (basic authentication).

password.title: Authentication password
password.description: Password used to authenticate against Elasticsearch.

sslKeystoreType.title: SSL keystore type
sslKeystoreType.description: Keystore type used for TLS (jks, pkcs12 or pem). Leave empty for plain HTTP or trust-all HTTPS.

sslKeystorePath.title: SSL keystore path
sslKeystorePath.description: Path to the JKS or PKCS12 keystore (not used for pem).

sslKeystorePassword.title: SSL keystore password
sslKeystorePassword.description: Password of the JKS or PKCS12 keystore.

bulkActions.title: Bulk actions
bulkActions.description: Number of documents buffered before a bulk flush.

flushInterval.title: Bulk flush interval
flushInterval.description: Flush interval for bulk actions, in seconds.
